The mission of Ecosmic is to enable the long-term safety and sustainability of space activities, by producing leading-edge software that will safeguard operational satellites against the threat of collision with space debris and other spacecraft. 
More than 30,000 artificial objects orbit around the Earth and the probability of their collision with operational spacecraft keeps increasing with time, as new launches are performed and space objects crash and explode creating more fragments. 
Managing close encounters in space and avoiding collisions is becoming a task that satellites operators cannot safely tackle from ground anymore: there is a growing need in the space industry for automated and enhanced on-board collision avoidance capabilities. 

To answer to this need, Ecosmic was founded to support safe space operations, aiming at a sustainable future.

entityDescription:
WE CREATE SOLUTIONS FOR A LIVING PLANET
All businesses create a footprint in nature somewhere in their value chain. With this comes the challenge of building a sustainable strategy with clear guidelines on how the company should deal with issues related to impacts on species and nature.
We specialise in finding solutions that both create business value and drive progress towards true sustainability. Our mindset is all about development, and we see opportunities in the most complex problems and challenges. Tackling the issue of biodiversity ultimately generates positive impacts for all of the UN's Sustainable Development Goals - not least our impact on climate.
We work across all sectors and our customers are both government and industry, but we see the major players in the business community as the key factor in the transition to a sustainable society. It is also within these companies that we find the strongest drivers for working on biodiversity. Integrating this as a natural part of a company's strategies and sustainability work is one of the cornerstones of a long-term business model.
Those who choose to take the lead are the ones who will build the sustainable society of tomorrow. Together, we create solutions that do not stand in the way of development, but drive it forward, turning risks and challenges into business opportunities with positive values for nature.

Every organisation or development project is unique, with equally unique and complex impacts and dependencies on biodiversity. With nearly 20 years of experience, we specialise in finding solutions that both create business value and drive progress towards true sustainability. We help you analyse and transform data into insight, identify opportunities and risks, and create new ways of working that promote both growth and sustainability. Our clients can be found across all industries, creating unique opportunities for synergies and collaborations. But most importantly, it gives us a deep understanding of our clients' common challenges, regardless of business model or industry.
